result_root_precondition: The adaptive worker precreates this exact candidate-owned root; the coordinator requires it to be empty, non-symlinked, and disk-backed.
scratch_root_precondition: Absent, non-symlinked, and disk-backed before launch; preserved on failure and removed only after a complete passing roundtrip.
promotion_condition: Exact authoritative-parent payload identity, canonical full inverse, two passing diagnostic guard-v3 receipts, file-backed cleanup, and absent scratch/cgroup/lease at terminalization authorize only independent Arm B.
kill_condition: Any antecedent drift, payload or inverse mismatch, guard violation, file-backed state leak, or terminal cleanup failure stops q1 qualification and preserves the failed artifacts.
